title: Linear Asymptotic Stability of the Smooth 1-Solitons for the Degasperis-Procesi Equation
summary: In this paper, we study the asymptotic stability of smooth 1-solitons in the Degasperis-Procesi (DP) equation. Such solutions necessarily exist on a non-zero background, and their spectral and orbital stability has previously been verified by Li, Liu & Wu and by Lafortune & Pelinovsky.
